plan.title: Closed RFQ Create New Version Confirmation

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on its Responses tab.
Open the versioning confirmation without confirming it.

args.name: Are you sure you want to create a new version?

Verify the dialog offers Create a New Version.
